info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Operational Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Delinquent Account Handling Retrieval API provides access to operational services that address delinquent accounts based on specific parameters. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information on how to manage accounts that are overdue, facilitating effective customer service and financial management. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and customer service representatives looking to streamline their operations. By querying with param1, users can access tailored solutions for delinquent account scenarios.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about the handling of delinquent accounts, specifically for the account ID ACC-200045. It provides insights into the account status and any relevant actions taken.
